scripts.install:all: npm run react:web:install && npm run react:app:install && npm run php:symfony:install && npm run php:laravel:install
scripts.lint: npm run lint:react:web && npm run lint:react:app
scripts.docker:rebuild: docker compose down && docker compose build --no-cache && docker compose up -d
scripts.docker:rebuild:laravel: docker compose build --no-cache laravel && docker compose up -d laravel
scripts.docker:rebuild:symfony: docker compose build --no-cache symfony && docker compose up -d symfony symfony-postgres
scripts.docker:rebuild:react-web: docker compose build --no-cache react-web-frontend react-web-backend && docker compose up -d react-web-frontend react-web-backend react-web-postgres
scripts.docker:rebuild:react-app: docker compose build --no-cache react-app-backend && docker compose up -d react-app-backend react-app-postgres
scripts.laravel:db:reset: docker compose exec laravel php artisan migrate:fresh --force && docker compose exec laravel php artisan db:seed --force
scripts.laravel:db:seed: docker compose exec laravel php artisan db:seed --force
scripts.laravel:db:migrate: docker compose exec laravel php artisan migrate --force
scripts.symfony:db:reset: docker compose exec symfony php bin/console doctrine:migrations:migrate --no-interaction --allow-no-migration && docker compose exec symfony php bin/console app:seed
scripts.symfony:db:migrate: docker compose exec symfony php bin/console doctrine:migrations:migrate --no-interaction
